claims.statement: Polish law requires businesses placing packaged products on the market to establish packaging mass from prescribed records and retain the information for five years.

The law provides for authority estimation of packaging mass when records are absent or unreliable, showing that the underlying ledger is a substantive obligation rather than only a filing convenience.
Poland's official BDO register covers entities introducing products and packaging and requires specified registered entities to place their BDO number on business documents.

contrary_evidence: The core calculation can be performed in a spreadsheet for companies with few stable SKUs, limiting ARPU.
BDO is already the official electronic reporting environment; this product only prepares and substantiates data.
Accountants and recovery organisations may already collect the same source records as part of bundled services.

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot with 5-10 e-commerce clients of one accountant, productize the annual-close checklist, then distribute as an accountant and fulfilment add-on
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated 5-8 year scenario: 700 entities averaging 8,000 PLN annual revenue yields 5.6m PLN; at 32% EBITDA, 4x, and 75% ownership, equity value is about 5.38m PLN. Channel-led acquisition is essential for this scale.
economics.founder_time: 14-20 hours per week during the first accountant-led cohort, compatible with a full-time job if support is asynchronous
economics.gross_margin_basis: Commerce ingestion and mass arithmetic are highly automatable; measuring dirty SKU catalogs and interpreting edge cases are onboarding costs
economics.payback: Customer payback hypothesis: replacing 20-60 hours of annual spreadsheet work and reducing unreliable-record risk can justify 4,000-12,000 PLN annually; validate by timed close studies
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 2,000-8,000 PLN onboarding and 250-900 PLN per month, with accountant multi-entity plans and paid annual close
economics.retention_or_repeat: Orders and packaging versions continuously update the annual ledger; historical evidence must be preserved and each annual close repeats

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Versioned packaging specifications and exception benchmarks by product/packaging archetype make later SKU onboarding and anomaly detection cheaper
fingerprint.customer: Polish DTC brands, marketplace sellers, importers, and small manufacturers placing products in packaging on the Polish market
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accounting firms, packaging suppliers, fulfilment centers, Shopify/WooCommerce/Allegro implementers, and recovery organisations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: SKU packaging master, scale/photo evidence capture, order ingestion, mass calculations, audit trail, anomaly alerts, and BDO-ready exports; hypothesis 2,000-8,000 PLN setup plus 250-900 PLN monthly
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Owner, finance lead, or accountant pays annual SaaS per legal entity/SKU/order tier, with paid setup for packaging baselining
fingerprint.problem_trigger: BDO registration, annual report close, new SKU or packaging version, marketplace expansion, or an accountant asking for packaging masses

founder_fit: Polish-specific, quantitative, automatable workflow fits founder skills and geography
Low initial capital and accountant-led distribution allow part-time validation
No camera presence or high-energy consumer community is required
Can become a durable data product rather than a manual reporting bureau
risks: Low willingness to pay among microbusinesses and high support burden can destroy unit economics
Accountants, recovery organisations, and BDO specialists may bundle the service cheaply
Incorrect category or mass mapping can produce statutory errors
Platform/API changes and future packaging rules may require continuous maintenance

structure.commercial_archetype: Embedded compliance subledger sold as low-touch SaaS through accountants and e-commerce operations partners
structure.control_point: The defensible packaging-type and mass record used as the legal basis for annual BDO reporting and fee/recovery calculations
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate versioned per-SKU packaging weights and transaction flows mapped to current Polish categories and client-authorized BDO outputs

thesis: Planning-stage hypothesis: build a packaging-mass subledger for Polish e-commerce brands, importers, and small manufacturers that turns SKU packaging specifications and order flows into a versioned record of material masses placed on the market. It would flag missing weights, preserve the calculation basis, reconcile recovery documents, and produce BDO-ready annual outputs for client or authorised-accountant submission. The statutory evidence ledger, rather than the annual form, is the control point. Integrations with common storefronts, warehouses, and accounting systems can create a low-touch distribution wedge and a permissioned benchmark of packaging-data quality without sharing confidential sales volumes.
title: Polish BDO Packaging-Mass Ledger
uncertainties: Exact segment where packaging complexity and willingness to pay overlap
Availability and permitted use of BDO APIs for client-authorized workflows
Cost of obtaining trustworthy starting packaging weights
Whether a multi-entity accountant channel can keep acquisition and support costs low
